faq: What is proration in plain words?
If a customer upgrades halfway through the month, they pay only the difference for the days left. Downgrades can give a credit. We choose a rule with you and show it to customers.
Can customers downgrade to a plan with fewer limits than they use?
We handle it. The app warns them what will be limited, and you decide whether to block the change or let them continue with softer limits.
Can I offer refunds when a customer cancels?
We can set up the flow, but refunds follow your own policy and your provider's rules. By default we do not refund automatically. We discuss what you want first.
Do you handle annual plans too?
Yes. Annual plans can upgrade immediately and cancel at the end of the year. We test the monthly-to-yearly switch, where proration is most often confusing.

Plan upgrades, downgrades and cancellation flows, set up by Ecom Swift LLC. We make plan changes behave clearly and fairly, with price previews, proration, end-of-period downgrades and confirmation emails, so customers know what they will pay.

## What is proration?

Proration is the adjustment made when a customer changes plans in the middle of a billing period. If someone moves to a more expensive plan halfway through the month, they pay the difference for the remaining days, not the full price again. If they cancel or move down, the unused time is either credited or kept until the period ends, depending on your rules.

Providers calculate proration automatically once you choose a behavior. The work lies in choosing the right behavior for each type of change, then showing the result to the customer before they confirm.

## Why plan changes need clear rules

A plan change is a moment of high attention. The customer has chosen to spend more, or less, or to leave. If the next invoice contains an amount they did not expect, they write to support, ask for a refund or file a dispute with their bank. Disputes cost time, and a surprise charge damages the relationship with a customer who was growing.

Clear rules prevent most of this. Upgrades that take effect at once let the customer use the new features immediately. Downgrades that start at the next renewal mean they keep what they paid for. Cancellations that keep access until the paid time ends feel honest. A price preview shows the amount before the click, and a confirmation email records it afterwards.

## What a well-built change flow includes

- Upgrades that take effect immediately, with fair proration.
- Downgrades that start at the next renewal.
- Cancellation at the end of the paid period, with access continuing until then.
- A price preview shown before the customer confirms any change.
- A warning when current usage exceeds the limits of the lower plan.
- One-click reactivation of a cancelled subscription.
- A confirmation email for every change.
- A pause option, for customers who need a break.
- Seat changes in the middle of a cycle.
- A change history for each customer, visible to your support team.

## How we do the work

We begin by writing your rules in plain language, such as when each kind of change takes effect and how access should behave. Then we configure your billing provider to match and build the screens in your app. The Basic package delivers immediate upgrades with proration, cancellation at the end of the paid period, access that follows the paid time and a confirmation email. The Standard package adds downgrades at renewal, price previews, warnings about usage over new limits, reactivation and a test of every plan change path. The Premium package adds pause, seat changes mid-cycle, a save offer on cancellation, a change history per customer and a handover call.

Testing is thorough, because mistakes here cost money. We move test customers up, down, sideways, to cancelled and back, on monthly and yearly plans, and compare each invoice with the expected amount. Ecom Swift LLC does not decide your refund policy, but we build whatever policy you choose.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Show the exact amount a customer will pay before they confirm.
- Let people keep what they have paid for until the period ends.
- Warn customers when a downgrade will limit data or seats they use.
- Make reactivation as easy as cancelling.
- Write your refund policy and link it near the cancel button.

**Avoid:**
- Applying a downgrade immediately and removing access that was already paid for.
- Surprising customers with a large prorated charge.
- Hiding the cancel option or adding steps to discourage it.
- Using different rules for monthly and yearly plans without telling anyone.
- Skipping a confirmation email after a change.

## Who this is for

This service suits a SaaS owner whose customers regularly ask how plan changes will be billed. It suits a team that built plans quickly and never defined what happens on a downgrade. It also suits a product with seat-based pricing, where teams grow and shrink during the month.

## What we need from you and how to start

Describe how you want upgrades, downgrades, cancellations and refunds to work, even in rough notes, and tell us which provider you use. We need developer or collaborator access to your app and a team role in your provider account. We never ask for passwords. After you order, we send a short checklist, confirm the rules with you in writing and provide a test link covering every change path.
